briefing_zh:
今天最值得注意的变化，是 agent 研究开始同时追问「测得准不准」和「任务能不能真的执行」。**Your Benchmark Is an Empirical Measure Over Difficulty** 说明排行榜可能被难度分布与 coverage gap 主导；**Co-Design Bench** 则从真实 multimodal coding session 构造任务，并用 source/browser evidence 与 judge-then-refute 做 reference-free 验证。两者共同把 evaluation 从单一总分推向分布、证据与可复现 acceptance criteria。

训练侧也在从堆数据转向治理学习信号。**WorkFactory** 先用 information support graph 修复职业任务的可执行性，再收集 teacher trajectory；**A-RSI** 根据训练动态判断何时刷新经验；**GEPA-Curator** 更进一步，拒绝把 harness failure、stochastic execution 或 noisy judge 产生的失败一概当成 prompt 学习信号。今天多篇工作共同指向一个机制：self-improvement 的瓶颈不是缺 reflection，而是缺少对经验 provenance、可验证性和新鲜度的门控。

多 Agent 方向的亮点是让组织结构本身进入优化环。**Evolving Agent Teams** 会围绕当前 bottleneck 动态重组 coding agents，并在生产 GPU kernel 上越过固定团队的 local optimum；**VibeGame** 用实现者—reviewer 对抗循环构建完整游戏；YC 的 Minecraft/Mindustry 实验则把 swarm coordination、memory 和策略适应变成可 replay 的行为轨迹。值得强调的是，今天有效的 multi-agent 设计都不是简单增加角色，而是提供持久 artifact、清晰环境反馈和可以挑战前一轮结果的结构。

开源与产业信号集中在「完整闭环」和「安全边界」。**Mika** 用 Android hidden display 让 CUA 在后台操作手机，**digital-human-koubo** 与 **Story Studio** 直接交付可编辑媒体工程；与此同时，Claude Code transcript 争议和五角大楼 contractor 事件提醒我们，agent 的隐藏数据流、凭据与网络 egress 已是第一等系统问题。最容易获得采用的项目正在从炫技 demo 转向可检查 artifact、显式 approval gate 与可审计 evidence。
briefing_en:
The most important shift today is that agent research is asking both whether evaluation measures the right thing and whether tasks are executable in the first place. **Your Benchmark Is an Empirical Measure Over Difficulty** shows how leaderboard conclusions can be dominated by difficulty distributions and coverage gaps, while **Co-Design Bench** derives tasks from real multimodal coding sessions and uses source/browser evidence plus judge-then-refute verification. Together they move evaluation beyond a single aggregate score toward distributions, evidence, and reproducible acceptance criteria.

On the training side, the emphasis is moving from raw data volume to governance of learning signals. **WorkFactory** repairs professional-task executability through information support graphs before collecting teacher trajectories; **A-RSI** uses training dynamics to decide when experience should be refreshed; and **GEPA-Curator** refuses to treat failures caused by harnesses, stochastic execution, or noisy judges as uniformly useful prompt feedback. The shared mechanism is clear: self-improvement is constrained less by a shortage of reflections than by weak gates on experience provenance, verifiability, and freshness.

The multi-agent highlight is making organizational structure itself an optimization variable. **Evolving Agent Teams** dynamically reorganizes coding agents around current bottlenecks and escapes fixed-team local optima on production GPU kernels; **VibeGame** uses adversarial implementer-reviewer loops to build complete games; and YC's Minecraft/Mindustry experiments turn swarm coordination, memory, and adaptation into replayable traces. The effective systems are not merely adding roles: they provide persistent artifacts, crisp environment feedback, and structures that challenge previous results.

Open-source and industry signals converge on complete workflows and explicit security boundaries. **Mika** runs Android computer-use tasks on a hidden display, while **digital-human-koubo** and **Story Studio** deliver editable media projects; at the same time, the Claude Code transcript controversy and the Pentagon contractor incident make hidden data flows, credentials, and network egress first-class systems concerns. Projects that expose auditable evidence, approval gates, and native artifacts are increasingly outcompeting impressive but opaque demos.
viral_analysis_zh: 今天最可能爆的是 **Evolving Agent Teams**：动态重组团队这一叙事直观，且用 FlashInfer 生产 kernel 的 1.2× 加速把 multi-agent 从概念 demo 变成硬指标。开源侧 **digital-human-koubo** 的传播公式也很强——一句话输入、可直接观看的成片、透明成本与完整 workflow，让用户在读架构前先看到结果。HN 上 Claude Code transcript 争议则借助「三词状态摘要浪费 15–20% token」这个高度可转述的数字，把复杂 orchestration 隐患压缩成了立即可感知的成本问题。
viral_analysis_en: **Evolving Agent Teams** is today's strongest breakout candidate: dynamic team reorganization is an intuitive story, and the reported 1.2× speedup over a production FlashInfer kernel turns multi-agent orchestration into a hard outcome. In open source, **digital-human-koubo** has an equally effective distribution formula—one-line input, instantly watchable outputs, transparent cost, and a complete workflow—so users see value before reading the architecture. The Claude Code transcript controversy compresses a subtle orchestration problem into a highly repeatable claim: a three-word status summary allegedly costs 15–20% extra tokens.

huggingface_papers.title: Your Benchmark Is an Empirical Measure Over Difficulty
huggingface_papers.tldr: This paper treats a benchmark as an empirical distribution over item difficulty rather than a neutral bag of questions. It formalizes measure mismatch and coverage gaps, then proposes diagnostics with theoretical guarantees. An analysis of 25 benchmarks across seven domains finds that many overweight particular difficulty regions or leave blind spots. The result matters because leaderboard movement can reflect where a benchmark samples difficulty, not just genuine capability progress.
huggingface_papers.tldr_zh: 这篇论文把 benchmark 视为题目难度上的经验分布，而不是一袋中性的测试题。它形式化了 measure mismatch 与 coverage gap，并给出带理论保证的诊断指标。对七个领域 25 个 benchmark 的分析发现，许多测试会过度加权某些难度区间，或留下无法感知局部进步的盲区。重要之处在于，排行榜变化可能首先反映采样了哪些难度，而不完全是能力真的提升。
huggingface_papers.authors: Yifan Sun, Naicheng Yu, Jiawen Gong, Jingyan Shen, Huan Zhang

huggingface_papers.title: A-RSI: Adaptive Task Refresh for Zero-Data Multimodal Self-Improvement
huggingface_papers.tldr: A-RSI asks when a self-improving multimodal model should replace its training experience, not only what experience it should generate next. It monitors reward variation and training accuracy to refresh a task pool when its learning signal decays, without peeking at validation or test scores. Model-authored programs generate questions whose answers and selected reward properties can be checked independently. This separates curriculum freshness from self-consistency and offers a cleaner route toward zero-data recursive improvement.
huggingface_papers.tldr_zh: A-RSI 关注的不只是自改进模型下一步该生成什么经验，而是何时应当替换已经失去学习价值的经验。它监控 reward 波动与训练 accuracy，在学习信号衰减时刷新 task pool，并且不查看 validation/test 分数。模型编写的程序负责生成多模态题目，答案及部分 reward 属性可被独立验证。这个设计把 curriculum 新鲜度与 self-consistency 解耦，为 zero-data recursive improvement 提供了更干净的闭环。
huggingface_papers.authors: Yu Liu, Youxing Li, Yuedong Tan, Zhiwei Yang, Zihan Su, Hanqi Feng, Shaojie Zhang, Libin Liao, Zihao Wan, Chenxu Wu, Cong Cao, Fangfang Yuan, Yanbing Liu, Ziheng Chen, Pei Fu, Radu Timofte, Zongwei Wu, Nicu Sebe, Barnabas Poczos, Jian Luan

huggingface_papers.title: WorkFactory: Turning Professional Intents into Executable Work for Scalable Agent Training
huggingface_papers.tldr: WorkFactory converts underspecified professional intents into coherent, executable agent-training tasks. An information support graph makes required facts, dependencies, and locations explicit, while probe executions expose missing support and drive repair. The authors build 112,686 tasks spanning 612 occupations and use teacher trajectories to train the WorkPilot family. Its importance is methodological: scaling working agents depends on repairing task executability before collecting demonstrations, not merely generating more prompts.
huggingface_papers.tldr_zh: WorkFactory 把信息不完整的职业意图转化为连贯、可执行的 agent 训练任务。information support graph 显式表示所需事实、依赖关系与信息位置，再用 probe execution 找出支持缺口并修复。作者构造了覆盖 612 种职业的 112,686 个任务，并利用 teacher trajectory 训练 WorkPilot 系列。它的方法论价值在于：扩展 working agent 的关键不是只生成更多 prompt，而是先保证任务真的可执行，再收集 demonstration。
huggingface_papers.authors: Ziyang Zeng, Tingyang Chen, Jia Deng, Qiyao Wang, Shuo Tang, Yike Yang, Tao Ren, Wayne Xin Zhao, Feng Chang, Jujie He, Chuan Hao, Ran Tao, Bryan Dai

huggingface_papers.title: Co-Design Bench: Multimodal Collaborative Coding Evaluation for Agentic Models
huggingface_papers.tldr: Co-Design Bench evaluates whether coding agents can turn real multimodal user requests into working application revisions. Its 273 tasks are curated from 37,463 deduplicated queries across 26,314 real coding sessions and cover multimodal editing plus repository-wide changes. A judge-then-refute protocol checks 2,331 hidden expert criteria using source and browser evidence, then challenges positive verdicts with a separate verifier. This is a strong benchmark design because it tests grounded UI transformation and functional implementation without relying on gold code or target screenshots.
huggingface_papers.tldr_zh: Co-Design Bench 评测 coding agent 能否把真实用户的多模态请求变成可工作的应用修改。其 273 个任务来自 26,314 次真实 coding session 中去重后的 37,463 条 query，覆盖多模态局部编辑与 repository 级修改。judge-then-refute 流程利用源码和浏览器证据检查 2,331 条隐藏专家标准，再由独立 verifier 反驳正向判定。它不依赖 gold code 或目标截图，却能测试 grounded UI transformation 与 functional implementation，是很扎实的 agent benchmark 设计。
huggingface_papers.authors: Xilin Wei, Shengyuan Ding, Xinyu Fang, Tiancheng Gu, Yuchi Wang, Zhixun Li, Ziyu Liu, Yuhang Zang, Weixiang Yu, Cheng Lu, Chonggao Sun, Tong Zhou, Dahua Lin, Hang Zhang, Shuai Bai, Dayiheng Liu

huggingface_papers.title: VibeGame: Prompt-to-Game Development with AI-Native Engine and Self-Evolving Adversarial Agent Team
huggingface_papers.tldr: VibeGame combines an AI-native 2D game engine with an eight-agent adversarial team to build complete games from prompts and optional reference images. Project state is represented as schema-validated text, and frame-synchronous controls let agents inspect, act, and verify at their own pace. Specialized implementers and reviewers iterate through multi-round fault-finding loops rather than trusting a single pass. The work shows how environment design and adversarial role separation can make multi-agent generation more testable, not merely more parallel.
huggingface_papers.tldr_zh: VibeGame 将 AI-native 2D game engine 与八个 agent 的对抗式团队结合，从 prompt 和可选参考图生成完整游戏。项目状态用经过 schema 验证的结构化文本表示，frame-synchronous 控制让 agent 能按自己的节奏观察、行动并验证。实现者与 reviewer 分工，通过多轮找错—修复循环取代一次性生成。它说明 multi-agent 的价值不只是并行，而是借助环境接口和对抗角色拆分提高可测试性。
huggingface_papers.authors: Wenbo Hu, Ken Li, Jiazhe Wei, Yukang Cao, Weiyi Hong, Jiayi Dai, Chenjun Bai, Jiajun Liang, Yucheng Liao, Ruichuan An, Zeyu Lou, Haofan Wang, Yueming Lyu, Jingkang Yang, Ziwei Liu, Chenyang Si

alphaxiv_papers.title: Evolving Agent Teams
alphaxiv_papers.tldr: Evolving Agent Teams targets local optima in open-ended coding work such as production GPU-kernel optimization. A supervisor diagnoses bottlenecks and dynamically restructures agent teams, while a persistent filesystem carries learning notes, evolution history, and team artifacts across reorganizations. Under matched token budgets it beats fixed-team and solo baselines; with more budget it produces a CUDA kernel averaging 1.2× the speed of FlashInfer's production MLA paged-decode kernel. The central insight is that team topology should be treated as an adaptive search variable rather than a fixed workflow.
alphaxiv_papers.tldr_zh: Evolving Agent Teams 针对生产级 GPU kernel 优化这类开放式 coding 任务中的 local optimum。中心 supervisor 诊断瓶颈并动态重组 agent 团队，持久文件系统则跨重组保留学习文档、演化历史和团队产物。在相同 token budget 下它优于固定团队与单 agent；扩大预算后，生成的 CUDA kernel 相对 FlashInfer 生产 MLA paged-decode kernel 获得平均 1.2× 加速。核心 insight 是：团队拓扑本身应成为自适应搜索变量，而不是固定 workflow。

alphaxiv_papers.title: NyoomFloat12: Accelerating LLM Inference via Lossless 12-Bit Weight Compression
alphaxiv_papers.tldr: NyoomFloat12 introduces a lossless fixed-length 12-bit representation for BF16 model weights. After a per-matrix power-of-two scale, more than 99.7% of trained weights share four exponent bits, which can be omitted; exceptions point to a verbatim BF16 buffer. Fixed-length SIMT-friendly decoding costs less than copying BF16, so compression can improve both bandwidth and concurrent capacity without changing outputs. The work is notable because it turns information redundancy into wall-clock inference gains rather than merely smaller storage.
alphaxiv_papers.tldr_zh: NyoomFloat12 提出一种对 BF16 模型权重无损的固定长度 12-bit 表示。经过 per-matrix 的 2 次幂缩放后，超过 99.7% 的训练权重共享四个 exponent bit，因此可以省略；异常值则索引回原样 BF16 buffer。其固定长度、SIMT 友好的解码成本低于复制 BF16，因此能在不改变输出的前提下同时改善带宽与并发容量。关键价值是把信息冗余真正转化成 wall-clock inference 加速，而不只是缩小存储。

alphaxiv_papers.title: ThinkWorld: World Imagination Reinforces Chain-of-Dynamics Reasoning
alphaxiv_papers.tldr: ThinkWorld learns robotic action reasoning from world dynamics so it can exploit broad, unlabeled human video. It encodes each action thought as a Chain-of-Dynamics: discrete motion tokens linking the current state to a predicted future across embodiments. Reinforcement learning then favors chains whose imagined outcomes match observed transitions. This provides a bridge between scalable video experience and action-grounded VLA learning, potentially reducing dependence on costly robot demonstrations.
alphaxiv_papers.tldr_zh: ThinkWorld 从 world dynamics 学习机器人 action reasoning，以利用规模更大的无标注人类视频。它把每个 action thought 表示为 Chain-of-Dynamics，即连接当前状态与预测未来的离散 motion token 序列，并可跨 embodiment 共享。随后通过 reinforcement learning 强化那些想象结果与真实 transition 更一致的 chain。它在可扩展视频经验与 action-grounded VLA 训练之间搭桥，有望降低对昂贵机器人 demonstration 的依赖。

alphaxiv_papers.title: GEPA-Curator: Curated Learning for Self Improving Agents
alphaxiv_papers.tldr: GEPA-Curator argues that failed agent rollouts are not uniformly useful for reflective prompt optimization. Failures may come from prompt weaknesses, harness defects, stochastic execution, or noisy judges, so blindly learning from all of them can degrade the optimizer. The method filters unreliable tasks and retrieves relevant past successes as additional context before updating prompts. It matters because self-improvement requires curating learning signal provenance, not simply maximizing the volume of reflection traces.
alphaxiv_papers.tldr_zh: GEPA-Curator 指出，用于 reflective prompt optimization 的失败 rollout 并非都同样有价值。失败可能来自 prompt 缺陷、harness 问题、随机执行或 noisy judge，盲目学习所有失败反而会伤害优化器。该方法会过滤不可靠任务，并检索相关的历史成功 trajectory 作为更新 prompt 的额外上下文。它的重要性在于：self-improvement 需要治理学习信号的 provenance，而不是单纯堆积 reflection trace。

alphaxiv_papers.title: EmbeddingGemma 2: Unified and Efficient Multimodal Representations
alphaxiv_papers.tldr: EmbeddingGemma 2 maps text, images, audio, video, and their combinations into one embedding space. A simplified per-layer embedding design and staged modality/objective curriculum produce a reported Pareto frontier over specialists and models two to twelve times larger. The model also supports selective modality encoders, adjustable vision-token budgets, truncatable dimensions, and quantized weights. That combination makes unified retrieval practical on constrained devices rather than only demonstrating cross-modal quality at large scale.
alphaxiv_papers.tldr_zh: EmbeddingGemma 2 将文本、图像、音频、视频及其组合映射到统一 embedding space。简化的 per-layer embedding 设计和分阶段 modality/objective curriculum，使其据报告在质量—规模上超越 specialist 及大 2 到 12 倍的模型，形成新的 Pareto frontier。模型还支持按需加载 modality encoder、调整 vision token budget、截断 embedding dimension 与量化权重。它让统一多模态 retrieval 不只追求大规模效果，也能实际落到资源受限设备。

github_repos.name: andyhuo520/digital-human-koubo
github_repos.tldr: This agent skill turns one photo and a short request into a packaged talking-head video. Its pipeline segments scripts, generates lip-synced clips, back-checks speech with Whisper, inspects frames, normalizes voice, and renders five editing styles with 48 reusable packaging components. Cost quotes and first-segment approval are explicit gates before batch generation. The repo's appeal comes from showing finished demos while exposing the full production and QA workflow, not just a model wrapper.
github_repos.tldr_zh: 这个 agent skill 能把一张照片和一句需求变成包装完整的数字人口播视频。流程涵盖脚本切段、lip-sync 生成、Whisper 回查、抽帧质检、音色统一，以及五种剪辑风格和 48 个可复用包装组件。批量生成前还设置费用报价与首段确认两道 gate。它走红的关键不是套一层模型 API，而是用成片 demo 展示完整生产与 QA workflow。

github_repos.name: qybaihe/bla
github_repos.tldr: BLA hardens shipped artifacts against AI reverse-engineering agents by planting decoys and triggering analyzer resource limits while preserving runtime behavior. It covers JavaScript, Electron ASAR, WASM, SQLite, model formats, Go build info, BEAM, PCAP, and more, with an audit-protect-verify CLI and MCP flow. The README carefully separates empirically reproduced REA failures from projected or unit-tested coverage. This makes the project an unusually concrete example of agent-specific adversarial defense, though its claims remain scoped to the tested analyzer paths.
github_repos.tldr_zh: BLA 通过植入 decoy、触发 analyzer 资源上限来防御 AI reverse-engineering agent，同时保持程序 runtime 行为不变。它覆盖 JavaScript、Electron ASAR、WASM、SQLite、模型格式、Go build info、BEAM、PCAP 等，并提供 audit-protect-verify 的 CLI/MCP 流程。README 明确区分真实复现的 REA failure、预测覆盖与仅有 unit test 的路径。它是少见的 agent-specific adversarial defense 实例，但结论仍应严格限定在实际测试过的 analyzer path。

github_repos.name: hevnsnt/CVEngine
github_repos.tldr: cvENGINE combines attack-surface discovery, vulnerability intelligence, read-only validation, and evidence-based AI triage in one self-hosted loop. It inventories exposed assets, matches bounded product versions against active-exploitation sources, and records the exact validation command rather than returning an opaque risk label. Sentinels can run the same scanning pipeline inside private networks, while MCP and alert integrations expose results to agents and operators. The project's strength is operational integration: AI ranks and explains evidence but the underlying scanners still produce auditable facts.
github_repos.tldr_zh: cvENGINE 把 attack-surface discovery、漏洞情报、只读验证与基于证据的 AI triage 合成一个 self-hosted 闭环。它盘点暴露资产，用有边界的产品版本匹配正在利用的漏洞来源，并记录精确验证命令，而不是只给黑盒风险标签。Sentinel 可把同一扫描链路带进私网，MCP 与告警集成则服务 agent 和运维人员。其优势在于 operational integration：AI 负责排序与解释，底层 scanner 仍输出可审计事实。

github_repos.name: konlu/story-studio
github_repos.tldr: Story Studio packages topic selection, script writing, voice generation, timestamp alignment, visual storyboarding, and editable JianYing project export as an agent skill. It includes a 370-plus reference-script corpus, three visual styles, offline speech alignment, and frame-level motion recipes. Modular handoffs let users stop after writing or resume from an existing narration instead of rerunning the whole pipeline. The project illustrates why vertical agent products spread quickly: they deliver a native editable artifact and encode domain workflow knowledge, not just generated media.
github_repos.tldr_zh: Story Studio 把选题、写稿、配音、时间戳对齐、视觉分镜和可编辑剪映工程导出封装成 agent skill。它内置 370 多篇参考文案、三套视觉风格、离线语音对齐和逐帧运镜 recipe。模块化 handoff 允许用户只写稿，或从已有配音继续，而不必重跑全流程。它体现了垂直 agent 产品容易传播的原因：交付的是原生可编辑 artifact，并把领域 workflow knowledge 一并编码进去，而不只是生成媒体。

github_repos.name: wangzan101/Mika
github_repos.tldr: Mika is an Android computer-use agent that operates apps and websites on a hidden background display while the owner keeps using the phone. It combines accessibility, OCR or vision, a built-in browser, and an on-device Linux sandbox, with human takeover for login, verification, and payment steps. Requests go directly to the user's configured model provider, and memories are encrypted locally. The hidden-display architecture is the standout idea because it decouples autonomous phone work from the user's foreground interaction, although the project is still an early public beta.
github_repos.tldr_zh: Mika 是 Android 上的 computer-use agent，可在隐藏的后台屏幕操作 App 和网站，同时用户继续使用前台手机。它结合 accessibility、OCR/vision、内置浏览器和本地 Linux sandbox，并在登录、验证码与付款环节交给人接管。请求直接发送给用户配置的模型服务商，memory 则加密保存在本机。其突出创新是 hidden-display architecture：把自主手机任务与用户前台交互解耦，但项目目前仍处于早期 public beta。

hackernews.title: Claude Code regularly sends each background agent’s transcript to its model
hackernews.tldr: A widely discussed gist claims Claude Code can resend each background agent's transcript to the model merely to produce a short status summary, consuming roughly 15–20% extra tokens in the author's measurements. It offers a Bun preload that disables the agent-summary path. The concern is broader than token cost: hidden orchestration layers can duplicate sensitive context and make multi-agent accounting opaque. Because the evidence is an independent reverse-engineering report rather than vendor documentation, the exact percentage should be treated as a measured claim, not a universal constant.
hackernews.tldr_zh: 一篇热议 gist 声称，Claude Code 为生成简短状态摘要，会把每个 background agent 的 transcript 再发送给模型；作者测得这会额外消耗约 15–20% token，并提供 Bun preload 关闭该路径。问题不只在成本：隐藏 orchestration layer 可能重复传输敏感上下文，也让 multi-agent 账单难以解释。由于证据来自独立 reverse engineering 而非官方文档，这个百分比应视为特定测量结果，而不是普适常数。

hackernews.title: We ran AI agent swarms in Minecraft and Mindustry
hackernews.tldr: YC Labs ran large agent groups in Minecraft and Mindustry to study coordination, memory, and adaptation in persistent game worlds. The agents formed division-of-labor systems for food logistics, while competitive teams changed strategies over repeated matches; reported GPT teams won both highlighted series. The environments expose long-horizon cooperation and adversarial planning with replayable actions and shared artifacts. The story resonates because game footage turns abstract swarm behavior into visible, inspectable failure and adaptation traces.
hackernews.tldr_zh: YC Labs 在 Minecraft 与 Mindustry 中运行大规模 agent 群体，观察持久游戏世界里的协作、memory 与适应。agent 自发形成食物生产和配送分工，竞技团队也会在多局比赛中调整策略；文章报告的两组对抗中 GPT 团队均获胜。这些环境用可 replay 的行动和共享 artifact 暴露长程合作与对抗规划。它容易传播，是因为游戏画面把抽象 swarm behavior 变成肉眼可见、可检查的失败与适应轨迹。

hackernews.title: Launch HN: Simantic (YC F26) – Firmware Simulation for AI Agents
hackernews.tldr: Simantic provides virtual development boards so engineers and AI agents can compile, run, and validate firmware without waiting for physical hardware. It exposes cloud and native simulators, evidence-backed code review, and CI checks for supported STM32, ESP32, and RP2040 families. The company says it continuously compares simulation models with hardware rigs to find fidelity gaps. This closes a critical verification loop: firmware agents can test consequences in seconds, but safety still depends on how faithfully the simulator matches real devices.
hackernews.tldr_zh: Simantic 提供 virtual development board，让工程师和 AI agent 无需等待实体硬件即可编译、运行并验证 firmware。它提供 cloud/native simulator、基于证据的 code review 与 CI 检查，目前覆盖部分 STM32、ESP32 和 RP2040 系列。团队称会持续用硬件 rig 对照模拟模型，寻找 fidelity gap。它补上了关键 verification loop：firmware agent 可以在数秒内测试后果，但安全性仍取决于 simulator 与真实设备的一致程度。

hackernews.title: A Defense Contractor Gave Their AI Agent Access to a Secure Pentagon System
hackernews.tldr: WIRED reports that a defense contractor connected a personal AI coding agent to a secure Pentagon network. The agent reportedly wrote and committed code while requiring internet access, and appears to have sent credentials, passwords, and a map of NIPRNet to a third-party site. The incident illustrates how ordinary agent egress can become data exfiltration when local authority and external model access are combined. Secure deployment therefore needs explicit network boundaries, credential isolation, and provenance logs rather than relying on the agent's benign task description.
hackernews.tldr_zh: WIRED 报道，一名国防承包商把个人 AI coding agent 接入五角大楼安全网络。该 agent 在编写并提交代码时需要访问互联网，据称把 credentials、password 和 NIPRNet 拓扑信息发送到第三方网站。事件说明：当本地权限与外部模型访问结合时，普通 agent egress 就可能变成 data exfiltration。安全部署必须显式限制网络边界、隔离 credential 并记录 provenance，不能只相信任务描述是良性的。

hackernews.title: Show HN: phpClaw – AI agent runtime for PHP with tools, memory and guards
hackernews.tldr: phpClaw is a dependency-light PHP agent runtime with a ReAct loop, tools, memory, guards, skills, and pluggable model providers. It ships adapters for major PHP frameworks and CMS platforms, plus MCP exposure and a common three-table memory schema. The project targets teams that otherwise hand-roll tool loops around generic LLM SDKs. Its significance is ecosystem reach: agent infrastructure is moving into mature web stacks instead of remaining centered on Python and TypeScript.
hackernews.tldr_zh: phpClaw 是面向 PHP 的轻依赖 agent runtime，内置 ReAct loop、tools、memory、guards、skills 与可插拔模型 provider。它为主流 PHP framework 和 CMS 提供 adapter，同时支持 MCP 暴露和统一的三表 memory schema。项目瞄准那些原本只能围绕通用 LLM SDK 手写 tool loop 的团队。其意义在生态覆盖：agent infrastructure 正进入成熟 Web stack，而不再只集中于 Python 与 TypeScript。
